items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of double Festzuschuss
items.quote: Wenn Sie mit dieser Entscheidung nicht einverstanden sind, können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch bei der Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The one-month Widerspruch period starts on the day the decision is deemed 'bekanntgegeben' (notified). Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, a letter sent by ordinary post within Germany is deemed delivered on the 3rd day after it was handed to the postal service, unless it did not actually arrive or arrived later (and this 3rd day is pushed to the next business day if it falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday). The letter itself carries no printed document date, so the dispatch date — and therefore the start of the delivery-fiction period and of the one-month Widerspruch period under § 84 Abs. 1 SGG — cannot be determined from the text provided. Consequently the exact final day cannot be computed; the person must check the postmark/envelope date or ask the Krankenkasse for the date the decision was actually sent to fix the deadline (document date + 3 days, weekend/holiday-adjusted, + 1 month, again weekend/holiday-adjusted per § 193 BGB).

warnings: The letter has no printed date (no Ausstellungsdatum/Datum visible anywhere in the text), so the start of the one-month Widerspruch deadline (based on Bekanntgabe/delivery fiction under § 37 SGB X and counted under § 84 SGG) cannot be reliably computed — check the envelope postmark or contact the Krankenkasse to confirm the dispatch date before relying on any deadline.

The decision only grants the simple Festzuschuss of 1.104,00 € and rejects the doubled hardship subsidy; if the person believes their income was assessed incorrectly, supporting income documents should be gathered before filing a Widerspruch.
